title: Why Rob Hallam left the UK at 23 to build a SaaS and film it in public
summary: Rob explains leaving the UK for Brazil to build a SaaS after an agency made $38k in under 4 months. The durable lessons: build for other people instead of yourself, and an authentic personal brand is a leverage point in the AI era. One viral post shows what building in public can unlock.

principles.text: Stop building products for yourself; build for other people and revenue follows.
principles.quote: why not instead of building products for myself build them for other people then one project led to another and another and in a little under 4 months my agency brought in over $38,000

principles.text: In the AI era, an authentic personal brand can't be copied and gives huge leverage.
principles.quote: in 2025 when we have ai replacing services and replacing sort of mundane tasks building a personal brand which is authentic and cannot be copied because no one can copy you for being you has insane power and leverage

principles.text: Posting yourself publicly can change everything: one post can bring followers, subscribers and offers.
principles.quote: while content creation and posting yourself online isn't for everyone if you do it something can happen that can change everything for you

principles.text: Do the thing even when it's uncomfortable; discomfort signals growth.
principles.quote: if it wasn't uncomfortable I wouldn't be growing

principles.text: Start from zero and learn in public, documenting while you learn.
principles.quote: I'm literally starting from zero and trying to pick up the ropes by watching people who have done it successfully online

principles.text: Use an agency as a bootstrapped funding engine, then pause it to take a real shot at your own SaaS.
principles.quote: I'm putting a pose on the agency and taking a real shot of building my own business my own SAS business
